manual_notes: The image control stores transform3d separately from rectangular geometry, clamps rotations, removes a zero transform, previews without history writes, restores on cancel and commits one new history batch on confirm. Eligibility excludes unsupported media placeholders. The follow-up keeps original AI image references, emits 2D/3D transform text and excludes rotated images from overlapping graphics exports, with targeted tests.
